mechanism: common last-four spacing event-interval analysis around C
family: a1=1+u^3/2 fixed; a2=a3=a4=a5=(1+u)/2+delta; full l in {1,2,3,4}^5
batch: at most four adjacent event intervals on each side of delta=0; at most 32 Bernstein subdivisions per selected interval
exact_work: all raw endpoint functions and event ordering in Q(u,v), u^5=2, v^5=3; each interpolation datum is an exact dual-union evaluation; rational nodes are chosen strictly within each exact event interval
degree_claim: on an event interval, endpoint order and coverage masks are fixed, so the first-coordinate factor is constant and the other four affine factors give union ratio degree at most 4 in delta
acceptance: a potential improvement requires complete exact union certificate whose lower endpoint exceeds locked C upper endpoint; a Bernstein exclusion is only local to the listed intervals
